Every unit is a preassembled, identical shelf-stable kit. No recipes, allergies, perishability or recipient decisions are modeled.

attendance_target 12 is a fixture occupancy planning bound, not a people-served count. Forty kits do not imply forty recipients. Stock Resource.capacity 100 is the storage bound, not available supply.

The initial schedule has a feasible 24-unit partial allocation proposal and no inventory reservation. Its 40-unit target is unresolved. It is not a full-success or execution-ready plan until quantities are reserved and staff readiness checks pass.
The registered staff team can distribute up to 40 kits during the 40-minute distribution window. This is an authored capacity assumption, not observed pantry throughput.

Partner stock is at the same venue. A source hold does not transfer it. Staff-confirmed receipt atomically debits source and credits destination, then destination stock is separately reserved and committed.
Expected S20 supply is excluded from usable stock until a unique staff receipt matches the shipment. Internal partner handoff does not decrement S20.

Initial pantry supply shortfall is 16. Initial service deficit is 40 because distributed quantity is zero. Partner stock is potential cover until authorized handoff, not already pantry-controlled supply.
The agent can reserve and plan but cannot attest receipt or distribution. Human demo staff use separate scoped credentials. All physical actions are simulated.
Both holdings and internal transfers have zero configured cost. No purchases or external bookings are permitted.

The runner records actual staffed execution start only after the plan is committed and stock reserved. Capacity at time t is floor(1 kit per minute times elapsed qualified staffed execution minutes), minus previously distributed units. A late commitment cannot backdate this clock. A completion at 13:40 counts before the service deadline-close event at that same time. Later physical distribution may be recorded within staff authority, but misses the original target deadline.

A valid source hold with purpose stock_transfer and destination_resource_id pantry_stock creates a local staff handoff task. A two-minute modeled response begins after that task is valid. Staff may attest at completion only while the hold and handoff window remain valid. 12:50 is exclusive for hold/transfer acceptance. Staff response conditions are fixed across policies; the model cannot assume acceptance.

handoff_duration_minutes is modeled response latency. In this bounded fixture staff may confirm the same-venue stock handoff as part of setup, so it is not an additional exclusive staffing activity. The handoff window ends before briefing starts. A domain requiring separate lifting, transport or active staff time needs an explicit scheduled activity and capacity check before use.
